env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A spread literal with a comment inside a two-target receive store
# target: the store text must fold the spread closure through its moved
# regions instead of slicing the generated text by source offsets, and
# the frozen operands must run once.
cd m
logos run .
cmp stdout want.txt
 cp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt
cd ../..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/csspreadstore

go 1.27

-- m/want.txt --
store true once true
-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type Holder struct {
	Base bool
	Ptr  *bool
}

var base = Holder{Base: true, Ptr: new(bool)}
var ptrs = []*bool{new(bool)}
var seq int

func next() int {
	seq++
	return 0
}

type Word struct{}

func (w Word) M() *bool { return &slot }

var slot bool

func spreadStore[T any](ch chan T) {
	const switch T {
	case interface{ M() *bool }:
		var p interface{ M() *bool }
		select {
		case p, *Holder{
			..base,
			// The comment shifts the operands later in the source
			// without appearing in the generated spread text.
			Ptr: ptrs[next()],
		}.Ptr = <-ch:
			if p.M() != &slot {
				fmt.Println("recv mismatch")
			}
		default:
		}
	}
}

func main() {
	ch := make(chan Word, 1)
	ch <- Word{}
	spreadStore[Word](ch)
	fmt.Println("store", *ptrs[0] == true, "once", seq == 1)
}
